questions.question_text: What is the main purpose of the Mini-Event Planning Challenge in Chapter 10?

options.text: To plan a massive school-wide event with an unlimited budget
To practice event planning skills on a small scale with a limited budget and timeline
To avoid working with a team and plan everything solo
To focus only on creating a portfolio without hosting an actual event

correct_answer.text: To practice event planning skills on a small scale with a limited budget and timeline

questions.question_text: During the Group Project to organize a school event, what is an important step to ensure success?

options.text: Assigning all tasks to one person to keep things simple
Ignoring the budget since it’s a school event
Dividing roles among team members based on their strengths and collaborating on a detailed plan
Waiting until the last minute to start planning to build excitement

correct_answer.text: Dividing roles among team members based on their strengths and collaborating on a detailed plan

questions.question_text: In the Scenario-Based Problem Solving section, what should you do if your main sponsor backs out at the last minute?

options.text: Cancel the event immediately without exploring other options
Brainstorm solutions like finding a new sponsor or cutting costs, then pick the best action plan
Ignore the problem and hope no one notices
Spend your own money to cover all the costs without telling anyone

correct_answer.text: Brainstorm solutions like finding a new sponsor or cutting costs, then pick the best action plan

questions.question_text: What is a key component of creating a Portfolio of Skills for event planning?

options.text: Only including photos of events without any written explanations
Collecting budgets, plans, and reflections to showcase your growth and skills over time
Leaving out any mistakes or challenges to make it look perfect
Making it as short as possible with only one item to save time

correct_answer.text: Collecting budgets, plans, and reflections to showcase your growth and skills over time
